nodes.label: Statement 13: Options for Antipsychotic-Associated Akathisia
nodes.rationale: Distressing restlessness drives nonadherence and dysphoria; dose reduction, switching, benzodiazepine, or beta-blocker benefits likely outweigh relapse and sedative or hypotensive harms.

nodes.label: Akathisia Treatment via Dose Reduction, Switch, Benzodiazepine, or Propranolol
nodes.rationale: Propranolol 30-120 mg/day in divided doses is a core option; distinguish akathisia from psychotic agitation to avoid cycles of dose escalation; anticholinergics generally unhelpful.
